## Line 237

```plato

    // Unlinks the node at `slot` from its ring and marks it dead.
    Unlink(slot: Integer, nodes: Buffer<EarClipNode>): Buffer<EarClipNode>
    {
        var node = nodes.At(slot);
        var prev = nodes.At(node.Prev).WithNext(node.Next);
        var next = nodes.At(node.Next).WithPrev(node.Prev);
        return nodes.Set(node.Prev, prev).Set(node.Next, next).Set(slot, node.Removed);
    }
```
